intro: TaskSiddhi is a board-based work management product for field and service teams of 5 to 30, made by Soor LLC, a Delaware-registered company (16192 Coastal Hwy, Lewes, DE 19958, USA; +1-607-318-2126). TaskSiddhi has two plans. Free Forever is the whole product for the whole team: no per-user price, no trial and no payment card, in any market. Custom is quoted per team and adds custom integrations, higher fair-use limits, guided onboarding and priority support. Fair-use limits apply so that one very large workspace cannot slow the service for everyone else; any published limit is stated on the pricing page. Soor LLC will not remove features that are free today.
does: What TaskSiddhi does: Table, Kanban, Calendar, Analytics, Activity, Sprints and Files views; My Work across boards; 15 column types; burndown, weekly velocity, cycle time, hours per day, time by person and cross-board reports; time tracking; recurring tasks; stage rules and three internal stage actions (rep task, reminder, next service); roles and per-stage permissions; 60-second undo; spreadsheet import; CSV or Excel export up to 10,000 rows per export; REST API and outbound webhooks. Android and web.
does_not: What TaskSiddhi does not do: it sends customers nothing (no WhatsApp, calls, email, quotes or invoices to customers; those are CRM jobs). No Timeline or Gantt view, no guest access or client share links, no importer from Trello, Asana or Jira, no scheduled report delivery, no billable or utilisation report, no PDF export, no native iOS app, no offline mode. Dependencies warn but do not block; approvals record a decision but do not move the card.
pricing_note: TaskSiddhi is free in every market. These pages differ only in language and region, not in price.
no_removal_promise: Free Forever stays free: we won't remove features that are free today.

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.summary: Trello is the simplest Kanban board there is. TaskSiddhi is a free Trello alternative that adds the reporting and time tracking a service team needs.

rows.label: Price
rows.us: Free Forever, or Custom (quoted)
rows.them: Standard $5, Premium $10 per user per month on annual billing, in US dollars

rows.label: Free plan
rows.us: Free to use, no seat count
rows.them: Free plan available

rows.label: Burndown, velocity, cycle time
rows.us: Burndown, weekly velocity, cycle time, hours per day, time by person
rows.them: Not listed on any plan; dashboards start on Premium

rows.label: Time tracking
rows.us: Live timer and manual entries, included
rows.them: Not listed on any plan

rows.label: Data export
rows.us: CSV or Excel at any time, up to 10,000 rows per export
rows.them: Listed from Premium

rows.label: AI features
rows.us: None
rows.them: From Standard: summaries, generated boards and checklists, card merging

they_win: Trello has AI features from its $5 Standard plan, including merging duplicate cards. TaskSiddhi has no AI features.
Trello has a huge ecosystem of add-ons and integrations. TaskSiddhi offers a REST API and outbound webhooks only.
If a simple card board is all you need, Trello's free plan may be enough.
we_win: Burndown, velocity and cycle time reports are built in.
Time tracking is included for everyone, with no add-on.
Free forever, with no card.
Each rep sees their scheduled jobs in Today, with a schedule date separate from the due date.
alternatives.switch_note: Export your Trello board to a spreadsheet, then use TaskSiddhi's five-step spreadsheet import. There is no direct importer from Trello.

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.summary: Asana is a mature work-management suite. TaskSiddhi is a lighter board for field and service teams, free for the whole team.

rows.label: Price
rows.us: Free Forever, or Custom (quoted)
rows.them: Starter $10.99, Advanced $24.99 per user per month on annual billing, in US dollars

rows.label: Free plan
rows.us: Free to use, no seat count
rows.them: Personal plan for up to 2 users

rows.label: Time tracking
rows.us: Live timer and manual entries, included
rows.them: Included on paid plans

rows.label: Guests
rows.us: No guest access
rows.them: Unlimited free guests up to Advanced

rows.label: Timeline / Gantt
rows.us: No Timeline or Gantt view
rows.them: Available on paid plans

rows.label: Billing
rows.us: Nothing to bill on Free Forever; Custom is quoted
rows.them: Starter and Advanced prices shown are for annual billing

they_win: Asana gives unlimited free guests. TaskSiddhi has no guest access at all, so clients cannot see your boards.
Asana has Timeline views and more ways to plan long projects. TaskSiddhi has no Timeline or Gantt view.
Asana has a native iPhone app. TaskSiddhi does not.
we_win: TaskSiddhi is free for the whole team, against 2 users on Asana's free plan.
Free forever, with reports and time tracking included.
Built around field work: a schedule date per assignee and each rep's Today screen.
60 seconds to undo a completion or a stage move.
alternatives.switch_note: Export your Asana project to CSV, then use TaskSiddhi's spreadsheet import. There is no direct importer from Asana.

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.summary: Todoist is an excellent personal and small-team to-do list. TaskSiddhi is a board with reports and time tracking for a team doing jobs.

rows.label: Built for
rows.us: Teams of 5 to 30 doing service jobs
rows.them: Personal and team task lists

rows.label: Free plan
rows.us: Free to use, no seat count
rows.them: Beginner plan with 5 personal projects

rows.label: Burndown, velocity, cycle time
rows.us: Burndown, weekly velocity, cycle time, hours per day, time by person
rows.them: Not listed; paid plans keep full reporting history

rows.label: Time tracking
rows.us: Live timer and manual entries, included
rows.them: Not listed; paid plans add task duration

rows.label: Boards and views
rows.us: Table, Kanban, Calendar, Analytics
rows.them: List, board and calendar layouts

rows.label: Mobile
rows.us: Android and web; no native iOS app
rows.them: Native apps across platforms

they_win: Todoist has native apps on every platform, including iPhone, and works well offline. TaskSiddhi needs a connection and has no iOS app.
For one person's to-do list, Todoist is simpler and faster.
we_win: Reports a manager can use: burndown, velocity, cycle time and workload by person.
Time tracking with a live timer and roll-ups by person and board.
Board roles, per-stage permissions and a contributor role for reps.
Free to use, with reporting and time tracking included.
alternatives.switch_note: Export your Todoist projects to CSV, then use TaskSiddhi's spreadsheet import. There is no direct importer from Todoist.
